title: Sankranthi 2026
description: A golden morning of rangoli, sesame sweets, and family light.
story: The courtyard filled early. Patterns bloomed in color, laughter carried through the house, and the year began the way it always has — together.
notes: The first rangoli was finished before breakfast.
Everyone gathered for the evening lamp lighting.
